text:
Maya: quick idealet's left-shift a tiny compatibility preflight before we run any smoke bench. catch tokenizer/ABI/binary shape issues early and avoid burning bench cycles.
Liam: +1. What's the minimal checkset to be useful but cheap?
Sofia: minimal = (1) tokenizer id map check on a handful of canonical strings, (2) kv-cache shape/dtype sanity, (3) micro-forward for output-shape + tiny numeric sanity. all should be fast.
Maya: propose an entry-gate that aims for <1s on a warmed sandbox: token_probe + micro-forward(1 seq) -> enqueue full smoke bench only on pass.
Liam: representation: structured failure reasons, not just boolean. we need to index trends and do flakiness analysis.
Sofia: agree. small schema stored in metadata: reason_code, component, evidence_snippet. e.g. TOKEN_ID_MISMATCH | tokenizer | "id 102 != expected 103". keep evidence short.
Alex: caution: micro-forward depends on kernel selection. if preflight runs on different kernel set than prod serving we can get false negatives. run preflight in same sandbox image for Dedicated/Private; for hosted maybe use kernel-fingerprint emulation.
DevOpsBot: deploy-note: preflight v1 scheduled on intake-workers pool, image=ml-sandbox:v2026-05-01.
Maya: gate-versioning required. semver the gate logic and persist gate_version in the intake record for reproducibility.
Liam: also pin tokenizer-spec version and opset-map version in the record.
Sofia: tradeoffs: adds a little latency to the initial intake response but saves wasted bench compute. make behavior policy-driven: org/team can choose fast vs strict profile.
Alex: quantized binaries nuance: tiny numeric deltas across hw are expected. we should support a tolerance enum (lenient/medium/strict) in intake.yaml; default=medium.
Maya: implementation sketch: 1) token probe (stateless) 2) deterministic micro-forward + golden comparison (L2 relative) 3) short-circuit to fail if checks don't pass.
Sofia: pseudo: seed=1337; x=randint(seed,(1,16)); out=model.forward(x); if l2(out,golden)/norm(golden)>THRESH -> fail(GOLDEN_DELTA).
Liam: goldens: store tiny tensors in immutable blobstore keyed by model-family+gate-version; updates only via gated procedure. store content-hash.
Maya: ops: index failure rows in bigtable so product and SRE can query rates and reasons.
DevOpsBot: metric created: entry_gate.fail_rate (1m,5m). alert threshold: >3 failed intakes in 1h.
Alex: rollout plan: alpha on internal models (1w), opt-in beta for hosted customers, then default for new intakes with an opt-out flag.
Liam: docs: short troubleshooting guide + example bad-tokenizer fixes. I'll draft and link the PR.
Sofia: I'll prototype the micro-runner + golden-compare; will test on amd64 and nvidia images (PR by Fri).
Maya: action items recap: Liam=docs+schema (EOD Wed); Sofia=prototype+tests (PR Fri); Alex=tolerance semantics for quantized (sync Thu); Ops=set up gate-versioning+metrics.
Alex: ensure logs redact weights/secrets; only keep hashes and short evidence snippets.
Maya: agreeno raw tensors in logs.
DevOpsBot: maintenance reminder: intake-workers pool maintenance tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Maya: noted. we'll avoid big canary runs in that window. thanks :thumbsup:
